title: What Training Data Would Produce a Near-Perfect Safety Monitor?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying dataset gaps is useful but indirect. The impact depends on whether dataset curation recommendations are actually followed. The finding is more diagnostic than directly actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Literature survey and dataset auditing is conceptually straightforward. Requires reading documentation and categorizing coverage. No ML skills needed beyond understanding what the datasets contain.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Auditing three datasets for coverage across behavioral categories is doable but could expand if categories are not predefined. Needs a clear, bounded set of behavioral categories to audit against. Feasible in 30 hours with tight scoping.
